rationale: The most recent five 1-minute candles show a clear and accelerating downtrend — price has dropped from ~$299 to $297.09 with increasing volume on the down bars (17,567 and 8,250 on the last two), and the current price of $297.28 is now sitting just $0.78 above the $296.50 invalidation level.
